description: How loose or tight US financial conditions are and how much stress markets show, in one answer: the OFR's daily Financial Stress Index with what credit, equity valuation, safe assets, funding and volatility each add; the Chicago Fed's NFCI and its parts; the St. Louis and Kansas City Feds' stress indexes; corporate bond spreads by rating (ICE BofA), Moody's Baa spread and the Fed Board's excess bond premium; the VIX. Each with its changes and its place in its own history.

measure.description: One measure's history instead of the overview: ofr_fsi, nfci, anfci, nfci_risk, nfci_credit, nfci_leverage, stlfsi, kcfsi, gz_spread, excess_bond_premium, investment_grade, bbb, high_yield, ccc, emerging_markets, euro_high_yield, baa_spread, vix.

periods.description: measure: observations shown, latest last; default 26.

start.description: measure: from this date instead (YYYY-MM-DD), up to 600 observations.

name: financial_conditions

outputSchema.description: rows are measures in the order of columns, each with its changes and its percentile in its own history; ofr is the OFR index with what each category and region adds. With measure, rows are that measure's observations.

title: Financial conditions and market stress
